noun_definition: Action refers to the series of steps taken by the user to submit an expense and interact with the interface, which includes selecting a VOIP number and dismissing an error.
qab refers to the quick action button in the user interface that is expected to display an action after submitting an expense.
Expense refers to a financial transaction submitted through the application, which in this case involves entering an amount and selecting a user to whom the expense is attributed.
User refers to an individual who submits an expense report through the application, specifically in the context of selecting a VOIP number for the submission process.
Error refers to the notification that appears when an expense is submitted to an invalid user, which the user can dismiss during the process.
